items.t: Chartwell is a residential enclave in the British Properties in the District of West Vancouver, centred on Chartwell Drive above Ambleside, anchored by Chartwell Elementary (1300 Chartwell Drive) and Sentinel Secondary (1250 Chartwell Drive) on Chartwell Drive itself. Unlike most British Properties enclave names, "Chartwell" has a confirmed official anchor in the school names; an official District neighbourhood name "Chartwell" separate from the British Properties is NOT CONFIRMED — the name does not appear as a named neighbourhood in the District's OCP. Street-by-street boundaries: UNVERIFIED — no District source read publishes them.

Edges and neighbours: Canterbury to the west (also British Properties), the upper British Properties benches to the north, Ambleside to the south below Highway 1, Park Royal to the south-east downhill via Taylor Way, and Westcot / the lower British Properties to the west. Chartwell Drive is the spine, connecting downhill via Taylor Way and the British Properties road network to Marine Drive, Park Royal and Highway 1 (Upper Levels Highway); the Lions Gate Bridge is the fixed crossing to Vancouver.
Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere — there is none. The stock is detached houses on hillside lots in the RS single-family zones.
All Chartwell market figures: UNVERIFIED.

Transit: TransLink's North & West Vancouver system map (September 2026) shows the British Properties served by West Vancouver Blue Bus routes from Park Royal Exchange, including route 254 (British Properties), with route 250 on Marine Drive below the hillside running between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Chartwell

items.t: West Vancouver zoning: houses sit in the RS single-family dwelling zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010; Section 200 states minimum site areas of 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5, with RS6 using the area of the site of record, and lists secondary suites and a detached secondary suite among permitted uses in the single-family zones; the zone for a specific lot is shown on the District's Zoning Map.

West Vancouver OCP: District-wide land use is guided by the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018; a Chartwell-specific local area plan is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed). On July 21, 2025 the Province directed West Vancouver to amend its OCP to provide increased density in the single-family and duplex areas adjacent to Ambleside and Dundarave (and at Park Royal–Taylor Way) by December 31, 2025 — Chartwell sits above Ambleside, so whether its lowest streets fall inside the "adjacent" areas must be verified per property.

Provincial SSMUH floor: the Province's small-scale multi-unit housing legislation requires zoning to allow a minimum of 4 dwelling units on single-family and duplex parcels greater than 280 m², and a minimum of 6 units on such parcels greater than 280 m² near frequent bus service; West Vancouver's local implementing-bylaw status: UNVERIFIED — no District source confirming the adoption state of its SSMUH amendments was read in the research pass.

West Vancouver property taxes: District of West Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty applied to unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District.

Additional school tax: at Chartwell / British Properties price points the Province's additional school tax will commonly apply — 0.2% on the residential portion of assessed value between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% on the portion above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chartwell

items.t: Both schools sit on the same drive, a few doors apart. Chartwell Elementary (1300 Chartwell Drive) and Sentinel Secondary (1250 Chartwell Drive) share the Chartwell Drive corridor, and SD45 describes the elementary as situated in the British Properties overlooking Vancouver and Burrard Inlet, with the Properties Family Hub offering multi-age programming on site.
The name is official at the schools, not at the District.
Half the tax bill is not the District's. Approximately 50% of the West Vancouver tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities.

Utilities are metered and quarterly. West Vancouver water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District — unlike Burnaby's annual utility notice, a buyer used to annual billing should not assume the same calendar.

The seawalk below the hillside dates to Canada's centennial. The Centennial Seawalk was built in 1967 and runs roughly 1.7 km east from Dundarave Park to Ambleside, below the Chartwell hillside; Dundarave Park is at 150 25th Street.

The confirmed services are all downhill. The West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre (2121 Marine Drive), West Vancouver Memorial Library (1950 Marine Drive) and Park Royal are all in Ambleside / on Marine Drive below the hillside — apart from its two schools, Chartwell is a drive-to-everything address. Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street in North Vancouver, is the hospital serving the North Shore.
There are no SnapStats numbers for this market.

Roads and transit: Chartwell Drive is the area's spine, connecting downhill via Taylor Way and the British Properties road network to Marine Drive, Park Royal and Highway 1 (Upper Levels Highway); the Lions Gate Bridge is the fixed crossing to Vancouver. Blue Bus route 254 (British Properties) serves the properties from Park Royal Exchange, and route 250 runs on Marine Drive below the hillside between Horseshoe Bay, Dundarave, Park Royal and downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Services are downhill apart from the schools: Park Royal is the OCP-recognized regional shopping centre and Ambleside the Municipal Town Centre; the West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre is at 2121 Marine Drive and West Vancouver Memorial Library at 1950 Marine Drive. Shopping or grocery inside Chartwell itself: UNVERIFIED (none confirmed). In-area anchor: the Properties Family Hub at Chartwell Elementary offers multi-age programming for children and adults living in the area, per SD45. Nearest hospital: Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver.

Schools: SD45 catchments are address-based; the sample address used in the research is 1300 Chartwell Drive, but the locator was not run, so every Chartwell catchment result is UNVERIFIED — check each address in the SD45 locator. In-area schools (Ministry/SD45-listed): Chartwell Elementary (K–7), 1300 Chartwell Drive, and Sentinel Secondary (8–12), 1250 Chartwell Drive, beside it; Westcot Elementary (K–7), 760 Westcot Road, is at the foot of the British Properties west of Chartwell. blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Chartwell

items.t: Zoning — District of West Vancouver Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010: houses sit in the RS single-family dwelling zones. The White Rock pair (Zoning 2506 / OCP 2220) belongs to White Rock ONLY and never applies here. Confirm the parcel's zone on the District's Zoning Map.
OCP — District of West Vancouver Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018: the District-wide plan covering Chartwell; a Chartwell-specific local area plan is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).

SSMUH / added units, as the Province states it: provincial SSMUH legislation requires zoning to allow a minimum of 4 dwelling units on single-family and duplex parcels greater than 280 m², and a minimum of 6 units on such parcels greater than 280 m² near frequent bus service (a route stopping at least every 15 minutes on average). West Vancouver's local implementing-bylaw status: UNVERIFIED — no District source confirming the adoption state was read.

Hazard development permits (District frame): an Environmental Development Permit is required for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank; a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit is required for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area, described as within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface; a Foreshore Development Permit applies within the Foreshore Development Permit Area (waterfront / coastal-flood-risk property), which does not ordinarily reach this upper hillside. Both the wildfire and environmental frames can apply on Chartwell's hillside and creek lots.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Chartwell ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of the land's value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Additional school tax (live at British Properties price points): 0.2% on the residential portion of assessed value between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% on the portion above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.

District property taxes: District of West Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; approximately 50% of the tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chartwell

items.t: The enclave is named by its schools, not by the District (2026-11-01 research): Chartwell Elementary is described by SD45 as situated in the British Properties overlooking Vancouver and Burrard Inlet, with two playground structures, a natural gravel field, upper soccer and basketball courts and the Properties Family Hub on site — the school grounds are the area's only confirmed in-area public open space; no District park inside Chartwell separate from the school grounds is confirmed.

The Province has already directed more density beside this hillside (July 21, 2025): West Vancouver was directed to amend its OCP for increased density in the single-family and duplex areas adjacent to Ambleside and Dundarave (and at Park Royal–Taylor Way) by December 31, 2025 — whether Chartwell's lowest streets are "adjacent" is a per-property check.
Half the tax bill is not the District's: approximately 50% of a West Vancouver property tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities.

The waterfront below the hillside is a 1967 centennial build: the Centennial Seawalk runs roughly 1.7 km east from Dundarave Park to Ambleside, below Chartwell — amenity value for hillside lots, not lot area.

Page-statement check for this area. Approved page claims, where a live page states them, are the settled set only: REALTOR since 2015; 10 straight years in the FVREB Medallion Club; Top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors; #1 in South Surrey/White Rock by MLS points for 2025 and 2026 YTD; more than $500M in sales.
